description: This file defines a service for aggregating hierarchical LLM (Large Language Model) costs from a MongoDB collection, including functions for projection, grouping, and index management. It processes cost and token data per user, project, and agent, with detailed normalization and formatting logic.

methods.name: projectionStage
methods.description: Creates a MongoDB projection stage to normalize and extract relevant fields from the llm_costs collection.

methods.name: addDateKeyStage
methods.description: Adds a date object to the pipeline, converting string dates to Date objects.

methods.name: projectDateKeyStage
methods.description: Projects fields including a formatted date string for grouping.

methods.name: groupByAgentDateStage
methods.description: Groups data by user, project, agent, and date, summing costs and tokens.

methods.name: groupAgentTotalsStage
methods.description: Aggregates agent data to compute total costs and organize costs/tokens by date.

methods.name: agentProjectStage
methods.description: Projects agent-level aggregated data with formatted costs and tokens.

methods.name: groupProjectStage
methods.description: Groups data by user and project, aggregating project costs and agents.

methods.name: projectProjectStage
methods.description: Projects project-level data with total cost and agents.

methods.name: groupUserStage
methods.description: Groups data by user, summing total user costs and listing projects.

methods.name: finalProjectStage
methods.description: Projects final user-level aggregate with total cost and projects.

methods.name: aggregateHierarchy
methods.description: Main function to perform hierarchical aggregation of LLM costs with filtering and formatting.

methods.name: ensureLlmCostsIndexes
methods.description: Creates indexes on the llm-costs collection to optimize query performance.
